g.text: Five identical 16-wire JST NSHD ports. TOF_VIO is strapped to P3V3 by default; CS/INT/DET pull to TOF_VIO.

g.desc: Five identical 16-wire JST NSHD ports. TOF_VIO is strapped to P3V3 by default; CS/INT/DET pull to TOF_VIO.

g.text: Each sensor port has an active-low MCU-sunk data/status LED for firmware found-and-streaming indication.

g.desc: Each sensor port has an active-low MCU-sunk data/status LED for firmware found-and-streaming indication.

g.text: Each sensor port uses ESD204DQA low-cap arrays for SPI, shared I3C/control, and DET protection at the connector.

g.desc: Each sensor port uses ESD204DQA low-cap arrays for SPI, shared I3C/control, and DET protection at the connector.

g.text: Pins 11/12 carry optional I3C/I2C bring-up only; SPI remains the primary high-rate sensor transport.

g.desc: Pins 11/12 carry optional I3C/I2C bring-up only; SPI remains the primary high-rate sensor transport.
